headline: Argentina country risk tops 1,000 bps as sovereign bonds slide 4.6%
summary: Argentina's country risk climbed 135 basis points to 1,070 bps, reaching a 13-month high as global bonds fell 4.6% in New York and the wholesale dollar touched a record 1,580 pesos with no central bank intervention.
why: Argentine sovereign debt remains highly sensitive to international capital shifts and investor concerns regarding post-2027 debt amortizations.
